resources.string: This is the original application shell. Product functionality is introduced through separate decisions, proofs of concept and stages.
The approved Dora home screen will appear here. This shell currently demonstrates navigation, themes and adaptive layout.
Conversation history is not implemented in this Alpha shell. This screen does not read or create user data.
Tasks are not implemented in this Alpha shell. This screen has no database, extraction or synchronization.
Product settings are not implemented in this Alpha shell. Cloud processing and production configuration are absent.
Recording is unavailable in this shell: DORA Alpha does not request microphone access.
